Name: Karums for Stardew Valley
Author: GrimReapers1121
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Does what the title implies, implements the Yummalicious Baltic snack, Karums, into Stardew Valley!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download Content Patcher[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Extract Content Patcher AND this mod into your mods folder[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]4. Run SMAPI and play![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires Content Patcher[/color]
